nodes.description: NIST FIPS 206 standardized Fast-Fourier lattice-based digital signature scheme relying on NTRU lattices and GPV trapdoor sampling for compact signature sizes.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Arabic Named Entity Recognition (NER) Suite
nodes.description: Transformer and BERT-backed named entity extraction framework specialized for fine-grained entity classification across Modern Standard Arabic and regional dialects.

nodes.label: VF2+ Subgraph Isomorphism Matching Algorithm
nodes.description: Optimized state-space association algorithm for fast subgraph isomorphism querying on massive property graph structures with node and edge attributes.

nodes.label: W3C RDF-Star Data Model and Syntax Specification
nodes.description: Extension to the standard RDF data model allowing RDF triples to be used as subjects or objects in other triples without full reification overhead.

nodes.label: OpenMP 5.2 SIMD Vectorization & Offloading API
nodes.description: Multi-platform shared memory parallel programming specification supporting explicit vector directives, loop transformations, and GPU offloading constructs.
